name: Bellanca 14-19 Cruisemaster
summary: Four-seat, low-wing retractable-gear Bellanca with a three-fin 'cardboard Constellation' tail; the 260 added a nosewheel.

engines: Single flat-six (190–260 hp) in a deep cowl
fuselage: Fabric-covered steel-tube fuselage with a four-seat cabin
Hydraulically retractable gear (tailwheel on early versions, nosewheel on the 260)
tail: Three vertical fins: a central fin plus an oval end-plate fin on each horizontal stabilizer

tellTales: Triple-fin tail on a four-seat low-wing
Retractable main gear and a long, tapering fuselage

confusedWith.howToTell: The Cruisemaster has three vertical fins on a conventional tail; the V35 has a V-tail.
The Cruisemaster is the larger, more powerful retractable version; the 14-13 has a smaller cowl and fixed gear.
The Cruisemaster has a triple-fin tail; the Viking has a single, oversized fin.
The Cruisemaster has a triple-fin tail; the Mooney has a single forward-swept fin.
